 Tech Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop
 Published Mon, Oct 19 2026 1:24 PM EDT Updated Mon, Oct 19 2026 3:46 PM EDT Kif Leswing @kifleswing WATCH LIVE Key Points Apple announced a product launch event on Oct. 28 in Los Angeles, sending invites on Monday to media and analysts for what it's calling "Pro and tell."
 Analysts expect Apple to release new Macs, including potentially the company's first touchscreen laptop.
 Apple is building computers with its powerful homegrown chips. 
 In this article
 AAPL 
 Follow your favorite stocks CREATE FREE ACCOUNT Apple CEO John Ternus during a product unveiling event at Apple Park in Cupertino, California, Sept. 9, 2026. David Paul Morris | Bloomberg | Getty Images Apple announced a product launch event on Oct. 28, sending invitations on Monday to media and analysts for an "Apple Experience in Los Angeles." 
 The email says "Pro and tell," suggesting the launch will focus on high-end "Pro" devices with powerful homegrown chips. 
 Ben Reitzes, an analyst at Melius Research, wrote in a note on Monday that he expects new Macs to be introduced, "including a touchscreen notebook," this fall. He said that for CEO John Ternus, who succeeded Tim Cook last month, the launch cadence marks a "meaningful shift" from what has been two events a year.
 Zoom In Icon Arrows pointing outwards Apple's invite to media for the event. Apple It will be Apple's third launch in Ternus' brief tenure, following an event at company headquarters for new iPhones, including the foldable Duo, and a gathering in New York centered around smart home hubs and a new speaker with a screen called HomeView.
 Apple updated its Mac Mini and Mac Studio desktops with new chips in August, and refreshed its MacBook Pro in the spring, along with a new low-cost MacBook Neo. But Apple's iMac desktop hasn't been updated since October 2024. 
 In the most recent quarter, Apple's Mac sales accounted for about 10% of overall revenue, as the company remains heavily reliant on iPhones. 
 Still, Macs have become one of the strongest parts of Apple's artificial intelligence story, thanks to its chips that can access more memory at higher speeds than other consumer processors. Apple shares are up 26% so far this year, outperforming the S&P 500. 
 Last week, Apple and Meta teamed up to bring a large open-weight model, developed by Meta, to multiple high-end Mac Studios.
 Apple has historically been dismissive of touchscreen laptops, with software chief Craig Federighi explaining in 2018 that the ergonomics would fatigue users.
